verdicts.reason: Wrong meaning: angin/o glossed as 'blood vessel' but that is angi/o (separate correct card 1783030165284). angin/o = 'choking, to choke' (Latin angere); its own 3 clinical examples (angina pectoris, stable/unstable angina) are choking chest pain. Matches Parker's memory suspicion.

fix.Text: The word root {{c1::angin/o}} means {{c2::choking, to choke}}.
